ei.title: Innovative Ways to Handle Fashion Returns
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more ①<u>innovative</u> in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are ②<u>channeling</u> through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of ③<u>dedicated</u> in-store areas, supported by ④<u>advanced</u> AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①innovative(형용사) ②channeling(←channelled 과거분사/수동) ③dedicated(과거분사) ④advanced(과거분사)
det.analysis:
① innovative: becoming more innovative → 형용사 보어로 적절
② channeling: returns are channelled 수동태이므로 과거분사 channelled가 맞음. channeling은 능동 진행으로 틀림 ←정답
③ dedicated: dedicated in-store areas → 과거분사 명사 수식, 적절
④ advanced: advanced AI technology → 과거분사 명사 수식, 적절
det.tip: be channelled(수동) vs be channeling(능동진행) — 반품이 '유도되는' 수동 의미

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, ①<u>going</u> into a store to process a free return, may be ②<u>tempted</u> ③<u>making</u> additional purchases ④<u>while</u> there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①going(현재분사) ②tempted(과거분사) ③making(←to make 부정사) ④while(접속사)
det.analysis:
① going: online customers, going into a store → 분사구문(현재분사), 적절
② tempted: may be tempted to → 수동 의미의 과거분사, 적절
③ making: be tempted to make — tempt 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 함. making은 틀림 ←정답
④ while: while there → 접속사, 적절
det.tip: be tempted to V원형 — to부정사 필수 (to+동사원형)

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, ①<u>supported</u> by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used ②<u>to allow</u> online customers to ③<u>virtually</u> try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, ④<u>reduced</u> the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①supported(과거분사) ②to allow(to부정사) ③virtually(부사) ④reduced(←reducing 현재분사)
det.analysis:
① supported: supported by advanced AI technology → 과거분사 수식구, 적절
② to allow: used to allow → to부정사 목적어, 적절
③ virtually: virtually try on → 동사 수식 부사, 적절
④ reduced: Omni-channel initiatives should improve..., reducing the financial risk. 주어가 능동으로 위험을 줄이는 것이므로 현재분사 reducing이 맞음. 수동의 reduced는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 분사구문: 주어가 능동이면 V-ing / 수동이면 V-ed

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①addressed(←addressing 동명사) ②including(전치사) ③supported(과거분사) ④posed(과거분사)
det.analysis:
① addressed: in addressing → 전치사 in의 목적어이므로 동명사 addressing이 맞음. 과거분사 addressed는 틀림 ←정답
② including: including the implementation → 전치사로 적절
③ supported: supported by advanced AI → 과거분사 수식구, 적절
④ posed: the financial risk posed by → 과거분사 수식구(위험이 초래되는), 적절
det.tip: 전치사 in 뒤에는 동명사(V-ing) 필수 — in addressing(처리하는 데 있어)

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more ①<u>innovative</u> in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①innovative(혁신적인) ②dedicated(전용의) ③costly(비용이 드는←free 무료의) ④additional(추가적인)
det.analysis:
① innovative: 혁신적인 방식으로 반품 문제 해결 → 적절
② dedicated: 전용 매장 공간 도입 → 적절
③ costly: 무료 반품을 처리하러 왔는데 '비용이 드는' 반품 → 본문은 free(무료) 반품이므로 부적절 ←정답
④ additional: 추가 구매를 유혹받을 수 있다 → 적절
det.tip: free(무료의) ↔ costly(비용이 드는)

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to ①<u>virtually</u> try on products to check fit and ②<u>unsuitability</u> prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should ③<u>improve</u> both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, ④<u>reducing</u> the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①virtually(가상으로) ②unsuitability(부적합성←suitability 적합성) ③improve(향상시키다) ④reducing(줄이면서)
det.analysis:
① virtually: 가상으로 착용해보다 → 적절
② unsuitability: 착용감과 '부적합성'을 확인 → 소비자는 착용 적합성(suitability)을 확인하는 것이 목적이므로 부적절 ←정답
③ improve: 이익 마진과 고객 만족도를 향상 → 적절
④ reducing: 재정적 위험을 줄이면서 → 적절
det.tip: suitability(적합성) ↔ unsuitability(부적합성)

det.tip: reverse logistics = 역물류, cost-effective route = 비용 효율적 경로

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 옴니채널 전략이 증가하는 반품률로 인한 재정적 위험을 줄인다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① operating profit margins: 영업이익 마진 — 줄이는 것이 아니라 향상시키는 대상

② customer satisfaction: 고객 만족도 — 줄이는 것이 아니라 향상시키는 대상

③ financial risk: 재정적 위험 — 반품률 증가로 인한 '재정적 위험'을 줄이는 것 ←정답

④ reverse logistics: 역물류 — 전략의 이름이지 줄이는 대상이 아님
det.tip: pose a risk = 위험을 초래하다, financial risk = 재정적 위험

Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products ____. 가상 착용의 목적이 들어가야 함. to check fit and suitability prior to purchase(구매 전 착용감과 적합성 확인)가 원문과 일치 ←정답: ③

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: AI 기술 중단 → 본문에서 AI 기술을 지원에 활용 → 불일치
det.analysis:
① 혁신적 방법 모색 → 원문 첫 문장과 일치
② 역물류 전략 → 비용 효율적 경로로 유도 → 일치
③ 전용 매장 공간 → 온·오프라인 반품 + 온라인 주문 수령 → 일치
④ AI 기술 사용 완전 중단 → 원문은 supported by advanced AI technology로 AI 활용 중. 중단이 아님 ←정답
det.tip: AI technology는 전용 매장 공간을 지원하는 수단으로 계속 활용됨

③ 구매 후 불량품 교환 → 원문은 구매 전(prior to purchase) 착용감 확인이므로 불일치
